description: This file defines the HomeSectionsAdapter class for an Android app, responsible for rendering various sections on the home screen such as header, banners, and content rows within a RecyclerView. It includes internal classes for view holders, diffing logic, and manages complex focus handling and dynamic layout calculations for a TV interface.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView Adapter managing the home screen's sections including header, banners, and content rows. Handles view type differentiation, view holder creation, and binds data to views with custom focus and layout behavior for Android TV navigation.

classes.name: HeaderSectionVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for the header section, managing the brand title and top navigation bar with focus handling and re-centering logic.

classes.name: BannerSectionVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for the banner section, which houses a horizontal RecyclerView with banners, handling size calculations and focus behavior.

classes.name: ContentRowSectionVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for content rows, containing a title and a horizontal RecyclerView of content cards, managing focus and scrolling.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates appropriate ViewHolder based on the view type (header, banner, row).

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to ViewHolder depending on section type, configuring focus behavior and content.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Various bind methods inside ViewHolders to set up view content and focus behavior.
